title: Voxi Monitor TUI Performance Tuning
description: Screen redraw rate and live mic loudness meter sampling/ballistics for `voxi monitor -w`.

paint.description: Screen redraw cadence, independent of --interval's slower CPU/GPU/process collection.

fps.description: Redraw rate in frames per second.

mic_level.description: Live mic-level meter capture rate/chunking and VU-meter ballistics.

sample_rate_hz.description: Raw PCM capture sample rate in Hz.

chunk_ms.description: Duration of each raw-amplitude sample chunk, in milliseconds.

window_ms.description: Rolling-window duration reduced to one target level per update, in milliseconds.

decay_ms.description: Exponential decay time constant for the displayed level's falloff, in milliseconds.
